text: Visitors have raised concerns about crowding and the flow of foot traffic, noting a lack of clear signage or floor markers to guide movement through the exhibits. Several reviews mention frustration with the timed entry system and the requirement to purchase tickets online in advance, which some found confusing or inconvenient. Parking availability has been criticized, particularly due to large vehicles occupying multiple spaces. There is also notable criticism of the heavy use of AI in interactive exhibits, which some visitors found detracted from their experience. Positive comments frequently mention the architecture and the variety of interactive elements, but these do not fully offset the issues raised.

windows.7: Visitors noted issues with parking availability, especially due to large vehicles occupying multiple spaces, and some were frustrated by the timed-entry system requiring advance online ticket purchases without on-site options. Several reviews mentioned crowding inside the library, which affected the ability to engage with exhibits and led to difficulties navigating the space due to a lack of clear directional signage. While many appreciated the interactive exhibits, some found the heavy use of AI in these elements less enjoyable. There were also comments about limited gift shop options related to the library itself. Overall, the average rating was 4.55 from 40 reviews, with five critical reviews highlighting these concerns.
